## Self-hosted health — join layer

- **openwearables** datasource → wearable time series / sleep / activities
- **wger** datasource → workout logs & routines

Fill panels after you have data. Until then, Explore → pick a datasource → `SELECT 1` to prove connectivity.

No app-to-app sync by design — this dashboard *is* the join.

panels.title: wger — recent workout sessions
panels.description: Adjust table/column names if your wger version differs (Explore the schema first).

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, date, comment FROM manager_workoutsession ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Open Wearables — connectivity check
panels.description: Replace with real series queries once providers sync. Lists public tables as a smoke test.

targets.rawSql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 40;
